hero.headline: Calculate your take-home income
hero.subtitle: Net income calculator for tax year 2026

inputs.minimumHelp: Enter your final minimum under Articles 28A–28C, after all reductions, offsets and exemptions. Enter 0 only if exempt. This amount is not calculated automatically.
inputs.businessScope: Full-year estimate for business income only. Enter amounts excluding VAT and expenses excluding insurance entered separately.
inputs.article12Confirmed: I qualify for employee taxation under Article 12(2)(f)
inputs.article12Help: Confirm eligibility: written service contracts with up to 3 clients, or at least 75% of revenue from one; no commercial status, no separate business premises from your home, and no disqualifying concurrent salaried income. Insurance eligibility is assessed separately.
inputs.article12Required: Confirm Article 12 eligibility to calculate this scenario, or use Self-Employed.
inputs.article39Help: Enter only your own annual contributions from your insurance records, including any additional contributions. Do not include the client/employer share.
inputs.withholdingHelp: Otherwise assumes 20% of all invoiced revenue. This is not universal: use the actual amount (including 0) when different. Withholding changes the settlement, not final income tax.

results.headline: Results
results.emptyState: Enter a monthly amount to see the result
results.invalid: Correct the highlighted fields to see your result.

disclaimer: 2026 estimates for planning. Check the figures with an accountant before filing or choosing a business structure.

selfEmployed.cashHelp: Net income excludes the new tax advance. The amount after prepayment is before credits for previous advances or withholding; it is not the final tax settlement.

compare.emptyState: Enter an offer amount to compare take-home income.
compare.headline: Compare take-home pay from an offer
compare.subtitle: Compare personal take-home from the same business revenue.
compare.defaults: Personal take-home is shown before the new advance. The IKE has one office, distributes all available profits and pays no management fee.
compare.basis: The monthly fee is used as the gross amount per paycheck for employment. This gives 14 paychecks per year for employees and 12 monthly invoices for businesses.
compare.expensesHelp: Use deductible expenses for each business, excluding VAT and EFKA. Include accounting and other operating costs. Annual company registry fees are added automatically. Include any sole proprietor registry fee in that business’s expenses.
compare.mplokakiBasis: Invoice work assumes Article 12(2)(f) eligibility and uses the selected EFKA category. Shared expenses reduce personal take-home.
compare.ikeLevy: IKE head office business levy / year
compare.partnershipLevy: E.E. head office business levy / year
compare.includePartnership: Include an E.E. limited partnership with a second partner
compare.partnershipBasis: The E.E. comparison uses your net share and assumes full distribution. The example starts with a 99%–1% split, single-entry books and monthly EFKA of €260.77 per partner. Taxes and contributions cover the company and both partners.
compare.quickBasisFirst: Tax year 2026 · Full year · First business opening.
compare.includeMplokaki: Include invoice work if you qualify under Article 12
compare.cashHeading: Cash after the new tax advance

whoWeAre.heading: Operator and contact
whoWeAre.text: PocketMath is an independent project operated from Greece. For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, email tsatsarisgiorgos@gmail.com.

whatData.heading: Calculator and browser settings
whatData.calculations: The calculator uses the figures you enter in browser memory and sends no calculation inputs or results to the host. PocketMath uses no analytics, advertising trackers, or user accounts.
whatData.preferences: Your browser remembers your chosen language and theme in local storage to restore those settings on future visits. The settings stay on your device until you change them or clear the site data.

hosting.heading: Website hosting
hosting.text: GitHub Pages hosts the site. GitHub logs visitor IP addresses for security. We use GitHub Pages to make the site available and secure. GitHub’s privacy statement describes its processing, including retention and international transfers.

email.heading: Email correspondence
email.text: If you write to us, we receive your email address, message, and any details you choose to share. Our legitimate interest is to answer questions and handle requests. Google provides our email service and may process this data outside the European Economic Area.
email.retention: We keep messages as long as needed to handle and document your request or meet legal obligations. Please leave out tax IDs, payslips, and bank details when reporting a calculator issue.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.text: Depending on the circumstances, you can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or portability of your personal data, or object to processing based on legitimate interests. Email tsatsarisgiorgos@gmail.com to exercise these rights.

validation.annual-offer: Enter an annual amount from 0 to 120,000,000 (no thousands separators).
validation.amount: Enter an amount from 0 to 10,000,000 (no thousands separators).
validation.age: Enter a whole-number age from 16 to 120.
validation.children: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10.
validation.years: Enter a whole number of years, at least 1.
validation.profitShare: Enter a percentage greater than 0 and less than 100.

efka.additionalHelp: Add any supplementary, lump-sum or other mandatory contributions not included in the category.

ike.scope: Full-year 2026 estimate for a sole member who also manages the company, with one office and dividends as their only income from the company. Enter revenue and deductible expenses excluding VAT. Insurance and the registry fee are calculated separately.
ike.levy0: €0 · Outside Attica, Islands Regional Unit or exempt
ike.reducedPrepayment: Eligible for the reduced tax advance (40%)
ike.reducedHelp: Available for an eligible new company’s first three tax years. The standard 80% applies to conversions and mergers.
ike.profitAfterTax: Company result after tax and levy
ike.shortfall: Company loss covered by the owner
ike.companyBalance: IKE balance after distribution and tax advance
ike.companyBalanceHelp: Estimate before crediting any previous advance. A negative balance shows the company would need additional liquidity in this scenario.
ike.transition: The IKE estimate excludes any extra personal tax that may apply if you continue the same activity from a former sole proprietorship.
ike.efkaHelp: Special-category eligibility depends on your insurance history. Incorporation does not restart the first five years.

partnership.scope: Full-year 2026 estimate for an E.E. limited partnership with two Greek-resident individual partners, one office and partner income from profit distributions. Enter revenue and expenses excluding VAT. EFKA and the registry fee are calculated separately.
partnership.efkaHelp: Insurance coverage applies even to a limited partner with 1%. Enter the paid contributions for each partner that the partnership bears and can deduct. Concurrent salaried employment or pension status can affect total insurance costs.
partnership.taxes: Taxes, levy and contributions for the company and both partners
partnership.shortfall: Your estimated share of funding the loss
partnership.shortfallHelp: The estimate uses the same percentages for funding a loss and distributing profits.
partnership.companyBalance: Partnership balance after distribution and advance
partnership.liability: This estimate assumes you are the general partner and can be personally liable without limit for partnership debts. The other person is the limited partner.
